moreInformation:
Used as part of ensamble in production test 2026 (buildings change detection). The training images have been transformed to align rooftops with building footprints. As a result, the model detects the position of rooftops rather than the actual positions of buildings. 

File on huggingface is labeled as convnextv2 but the architecture is convnextv1
